# Keiland W. Cooper

> Neuroscientist studying how learning, memory, and decision-making integrate across brains, minds, and machines. Affiliated with UC Irvine and the Center for Neurobiology of Learning and Memory; co-founder of ContinualAI, a research non-profit advancing continual learning in AI. Research informs clinical questions in Alzheimer's disease, aging, and addiction.
